hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Sweeps
hints.text: The moves required for box i decompose into total distance from balls to its left plus balls to its right.

hints.title: Left to Right Accumulation
hints.text: Maintain count of balls seen so far and running operations needed to move left balls to current position.

hints.title: Right to Left Accumulation
hints.text: Perform a symmetric right to left sweep, adding operations from right balls to the answer array.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, boxes: str) -> list[int]:
        n = len(boxes)
        ans = [0] * n

        count = 0
        ops = 0
        for i in range(n):
            ans[i] += ops
            if boxes[i] == '1':
                count += 1
            ops += count

        count = 0
        ops = 0
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            ans[i] += ops
            if boxes[i] == '1':
                count += 1
            ops += count

        return ans
```

variables: n is length of boxes string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating pairwise distances naively takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two linear sweeps evaluate cumulative left and right operations in O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies prefix and suffix running counters to avoid quadratic pairwise calculation.
